name: Back to Open from the list
kurz: If a started or done task ends up under “Unassigned tasks”, whether put back by hand or by a sick call, it is set back to Open. For this, the step from Started back to Open is now allowed, also in the status menu on the bar. For this, the step from Done back to Open is now allowed, also in the status menu on the bar.
